name: charple
_note: Charmtone purple — a violet-indigo skin seeded from the Charm charmtone palette (MIT). Accent rides ~H282 (designer plum #7b3a96 light, bright orchid #c78ae0 dark — console-remake accepted ramp); the neutral ladder and paper ground re-hue cool-violet off the accent, so paper/ink carry a faint amethyst tint, never neutral grey. The seeds derive cleanly — 0 accent/reading pins, the formula lands every slot natively; only surface.dark needs a designed pin (the OKLCH near-black collapse the whole family shares).

_overrideReasons.surface.dark: the neutral-ladder OKLCH L0.095 pick collapses to a crushed near-black that loses the cool-violet tint; pinned to a designed amethyst near-black that grounds the page under bg (14%) and holds the charple temperature
_overrideReasons.studioChrome.fg-dim.dark: sup-w1: charple's dark bg seed (L14% — a light-ish dark ground, the symmetric flip of the light ink) leaves the fixed-L dim tier at contrast 4.159 (<4.5); pinned L 51.8%→56% so contrast(--fg-dim,--bg) clears WCAG AA 4.5 (4.82) while staying visibly dimmer than --muted-text (5.71)
